# Accredian (accredian.com)
> Accredian is a leading executive upskilling and education platform in India, delivering executive, PG diploma, and professional certificate programs in academic collaboration with premier institutions — including IIM Lucknow, IIM Visakhapatnam, E&ICT Academy IIT Kanpur, I3C IIT Jammu, IIT Hyderabad, IITM Pravartak (IIT Madras), XLRI Jamshedpur, IIM Tiruchirappalli, IIM Ranchi, IIM Kashipur, IIM Sirmaur, IIM Bodh Gaya, IIM Amritsar, SP Jain School of Global Management, and Microsoft. Programs span Generative AI & Agentic AI, CXO Leadership, Senior Management, Strategy & Leadership, Data Science, Project Management, Product Management, Strategic HR Leadership, General Management, Finance, and Design Thinking.

## Important Notice
- Program availability, fees, start dates, and curriculum details are subject to change. Always visit [accredian.com](https://accredian.com) for the latest and most accurate real-time information.
- Some programs may have closed for new registrations after their cohort admission deadline. Verify current enrollment status directly on the official website.
- Fee amounts listed are indicative in INR and exclude applicable GST (except where explicitly inclusive) or optional on-campus immersion costs.
- For enrollment queries and corporate sponsorships, contact Accredian's admissions team via the website.
## About Accredian
- Website: https://accredian.com
- Headquarters: Gurgaon, India
- Founded: 2018
- Core Focus: Generative AI & Agentic AI, CXO Leadership, Senior Management, Strategy & Leadership, Data Science, Project Management, Product Management, HR Leadership, Finance and General Management
- Delivery Mode: 100% Online | Live Instructor-Led | Weekend Classes (Saturday & Sunday)
- Career Support: 1:1 personalized career mentorship, CXO resume & LinkedIn profile optimization, executive interview preparation, and career network access
- Referral Program: Earn cash rewards up to ₹10,000 by referring peers (https://accredian.com/referandearn)
- Executive Alumni Network: Thousands of alumni working across Fortune 500 tech, consulting, and finance leaders
## Partner Institutions
- Indian Institute of Management Lucknow (IIM Lucknow) — Chief Digital & AI Officer (CDAIO), Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), Strategic Project Management and Executive General Management programs
- Indian Institute of Management Visakhapatnam (IIM Visakhapatnam / IIMV) — Premier IIM; extensive portfolio spanning CEO, CTO, CFO, CHRO, AI, Finance, Project Management, and Post Graduate Diploma
- Electronics & ICT Academy, IIT Kanpur (IIT Kanpur / IITK) — Strategic Project Management, AI Leadership, Design Thinking with AI, and Applied Generative AI programs
- I3C, Indian Institute of Technology Jammu (IIT Jammu) — Advanced & Executive Programs in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and AI for Leaders
- Department of Entrepreneurship and Management, IIT Hyderabad (IITH) — Strategic Project Management and Design Thinking programs
- IITM Pravartak (IIT Madras) — Technology Leadership & Innovation
- XLRI Jamshedpur / Delhi-NCR — Executive Development Programs in General Management, Strategic HR, Digital HR, and Global Senior Management
- Indian Institute of Management Tiruchirappalli (IIM Trichy / IIMT) — Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Program and Leadership with AI
- Indian Institute of Management Ranchi (IIM Ranchi) — Chief Human Resource Officer (CHRO), Strategy & Leadership, Generative & Agentic AI, Leadership with AI, and Senior Management programs
- Indian Institute of Management Kashipur (IIM Kashipur) — Chief Operating Officer (COO) Program
- Indian Institute of Management Sirmaur (IIM Sirmaur / IIMS) — Leadership with AI and Strategy Leadership & Innovation
- Indian Institute of Management Bodh Gaya (IIM Bodh Gaya) — Senior Management Program
- Indian Institute of Management Amritsar (IIM Amritsar) — Senior Management Program
- SP Jain School of Global Management — Executive and Professional Certificates in Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI for Leaders, and HR Leadership
- Microsoft — Collaborative learning partner for Workflow Transformation with Generative AI
- E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati (IITG) — Electronics & ICT Academy at IIT Guwahati; historical portfolio in Data Science, Product Management, and Fintech (maintained for alumni verification)
